notes.title: DEMO | Patch #2 «Echoes of the Sands»
notes.content:
Patch #2 «Echoes of the Sands»
Greetings, explorers! We’re thrilled to unveil Patch #2, bringing new features, enhanced visuals, and a host of fixes. Dive into your adventure with renewed vigor!
New Features
Visual Markers for Key Items

 Now, significant objects gleam with highlights in your field of view, making them easier to spot from afar. Explore the world with greater ease!

Knowledge Tags in Inventory

 Items holding quest-critical knowledge are now marked in your inventory. Don’t miss a single clue!

Additional Graphics Settings

 Customize ray quality, smoke, and more to your liking. Enhanced DLSS options and FSR 2 support ensure smoother, stunning visuals.
  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288955/c6aeecdabf6eb6a69d597e065d5d520142bfa71b.png
Gameplay Improvements
Revamped Hieroglyph Mini-Game

 The heroine now places translated hieroglyph stickers into the text herself, making the process intuitive and engaging.

Updated Tutorial

 We’ve reworked some tutorial sections and added a new inventory segment tied to the journal, helping newcomers settle in faster.

Enhanced Item Interaction

 The interaction button now appears only when hovering over an item in range—no more accidental clicks!

Fixed Water Surfacing

 Oxygen now restores correctly when surfacing vertically. Dives are more reliable than ever!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288955/c6aeecdabf6eb6a69d597e065d5d520142bfa71b.png  
Visual Enhancements
Reworked Character Skin Material

 Skin now scatters light from sources more accurately, delivering a more lifelike and vibrant look.

Overall Optimization

 We’ve boosted game performance, ensuring your sandy adventures run even smoother.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288955/c6aeecdabf6eb6a69d597e065d5d520142bfa71b.png  
Fixes
Minor Map Adjustments

 Small landscape and object imperfections have been smoothed out.

General Bug Fixes

 A slew of minor bugs— from wonky textures to random crashes—has been banished to oblivion.

notes.title: DEMO | Patch #1 «Echoes of the Sands»
notes.content:
In this update, we have made many improvements and fixes to the demo version to make your game acquaintance even more exciting.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288955/c6aeecdabf6eb6a69d597e065d5d520142bfa71b.png
List of major changes:


 Engine update: the game has switched to updated version of the engine and updated to Unity 6
 Added a map (guide) with main and additional tasks.
 Added additional tips for quests, making it easier to complete.
 The location light has been worked out, including the underwater zone.
 Some tasks have been reworked.
 Corrected the text.
 The panel with hieroglyphs in the dictionary has been enlarged when deciphering hieroglyphs for convenience.
 Removed a bug with stickers in the mini-game for deciphering hieroglyphs.
 Fixed some bugs with icons.
 Fixed some animations.
 Improved optimization.
 Fixed minor bugs in the interface related to the display and interaction of elements.
 Added new sounds.
 Minor fixes
